author: Tavie
quote: Nostalgia aside. This game was beautifully remade. The attention to detail is crazy! You can see the love and attention that was put into just the aesthetics of the game. Who makes sure that the grass and the hair and the fur and all these minor things on characters are moving appropriately according to what’s going on around them? The shadows and the terrain  that Link can walk through like all these things that are very minor and have no effect on the actual gameplay were thought about even down to the details on Link and the other NPCs. This is by far the most aesthetically pleasing game I’ve played. It was nice to see Nintendo use the motion control feature in the game as well as the microphone and I think other gaming companies should definitely take note of that.(that’s pretty innovative in my opinion) The voice actors did an amazing job at bringing life to these characters that for years were silent. Is the game short? Yes if you’re an adult , it’s very short if you’re an adult who’s played this game before. Is it worth it? Yes I think it’s worth it. It’s nice to play a game where everything is more compact and you don’t have to travel 5-10 irl minutes across the map to get to your next mission or task. this game is a reminder of what video games used to be like when game developers couldn’t cram a bunch of filler into the game and the game had to be pretty much on point from the beginning to the end. If you’re an adult gamer(fully developed brain), who’s never played this game it’s kind of like a more cozy adventure game. If you have children who are getting into video games, I do think this is a good starting place for them it would definitely start to develop problem-solving skills and how to do things better so you don’t die the next time lol. It’s very refreshing to step away from the really big open world games of the modern gaming era.

author: Tavie
quote: I don’t understand what y’all have been doing for the last 13 years. The game is buggy, which doesn’t make sense. The storyline is trash also doesn’t make sense the protagonist and all the task and things that he has to do….horrible. I’m not a fan of the mechanics either, the NPCs and like their little side banter(one of my favorite little things about the GTA universe) that made the old GTA‘s funny…..horrible in this game.  if I can describe it it’s kind of like the earlier GTA had that 2000s to mid 2000s vulgarity where it was obvious that this was something you probably shouldn’t be playing, but it wasn’t trying too hard whereas this game it feels kind of like a teenager who’s trying to be edgy and shocking so they drop a F bomb every two seconds and like you can tell that they’re trying really hard to impress ****. Also, I don’t like the fact that you’re limiting my violence The purpose of video games is to do things in them that you can’t do in real life. If I wanted something that was more realistic, I will play the Sims or some other simulator type of game. I understand some game start off slow, but this is GTA and this game does not give the spirit of GTA now I will say I do like the way the game looks in terms of the artistry and the graphics. It definitely feels like GTA visually, but everything else trash. I don’t know if it’s too late for y’all to get the old writers and development team of the other GTA games back but y’all need to go find them ASAP and whoever these new people are they need a demotion like they’re no longer allowed to work on big projects because this is the worst game in the franchise.
